name: Hoppip
flavour_text: Outside of cold regions, Hoppip can be found practically everywhere. This is because the wind carries this species all over the world.

name: Skiploom

1.name: Bounce
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon’s head.

1.name: Breeze-By Attack
1.effect: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Sunkern
flavour_text: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. Knowing it’s weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.

name: Sunflora

1.name: Trip Over
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

name: Celebi

1.name: Temporal Leaves
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an evolved Pokémon, devolve it by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

flavour_text: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

name: Durant

1.name: Mountain Munch
1.effect: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

flavour_text: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

name: Slugma
flavour_text: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
flavour_text: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

ability.name: Legendary Pulse
ability.effect: At the end of your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, draw a card.

1.name: Blazing Beatdown
1.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra [R] Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Fletchinder
flavour_text: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

name: Talonflame

1.name: Searing Flame
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

flavour_text: It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies around easily, even while carrying prey that weighs more than 220 lbs.

name: Poliwag

1.name: Call for Family
1.effect: Put 1 random Poliwag from your deck onto your Bench.

flavour_text: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
flavour_text: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Tentacool

1.name: Poison Sting
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.

name: Tentacruel

1.name: Stun Poison
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Paralyzed.

flavour_text: When the red orbs on Tentacruel’s head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.

name: Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowking

1.name: Litter
1.effect: Discard up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards from your hand. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

flavour_text: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

name: Jynx

1.name: Dazzle Dance
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavour_text: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

ability.name: Legendary Pulse
ability.effect: At the end of your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, draw a card.

1.name: Crystal Waltz
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

name: Feebas

1.name: Leap Out
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon’s marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

name: Milotic

ability.name: Healing Ripples
ability.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may heal 60 damage from 1 of your [W] Pokémon.

flavour_text: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Mantyke

1.name: Splashy Toss
1.effect: Take a [W] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Basic Pokémon.

flavour_text: It’s highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that take people swimming with Mantyke are a super-popular beach activity.

name: Cryogonal

1.name: Ice Blade
1.effect: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said that people and Pokémon who die on snowy mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

ability.name: Legendary Pulse
ability.effect: At the end of your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, draw a card.

1.name: Voltaic Bullet
1.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Tynamo
flavour_text: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavour_text: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Eelektross

1.name: Wild Charge
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Stunfisk
flavour_text: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

name: Yamper
flavour_text: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund

1.name: Defiant Spark
1.effect: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack can be used for 1 [L] Energy.

flavour_text: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: Misdreavus

ability.name: Infiltrating Inspection
ability.effect: Once during your turn, when you put this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may have your opponent reveal their hand.

flavour_text: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Mismagius

1.name: Cursed Prose
1.effect: At the end of your opponent's next turn, do 90 damage to the Defending Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

name: Galarian Corsola
flavour_text: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

name: Galarian Cursola

ability.name: Perish Body
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, the Attacking Pokémon is Knocked Out.

flavour_text: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.

name: Latias

1.name: Crossing Flights
1.effect: If Latios is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavour_text: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Latios

ability.name: Fantastical Floating
ability.effect: If you have Latias in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

1.name: Luster Purge
1.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Frillish

1.name: Absorb
1.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws it down to the deeps, five miles below the ocean’s surface.

name: Jellicent
flavour_text: Most of this Pokémon’s body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair.

name: Diglett
flavour_text: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

name: Dugtrio

1.name: Cliff Crumbler
1.effect: Discard the top card of your deck. If that card is a [F] Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

1.name: Hydro Knuckle
1.effect: If this Pokémon has any [W] Energy attached, this attack does 40 more damage.

name: Phanpy

1.name: Flail
1.effect: This attack does damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon equal to the damage this Pokémon has on it.

flavour_text: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won’t be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

name: Donphan

ability.name: Exoskeleton
ability.effect: This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being hit by a car won’t faze this Pokémon. However, it is extremely susceptible to rain.

name: Relicanth

1.name: Take Down
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

name: Dwebble
flavour_text: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

name: Crustle

1.name: Stone Edge
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won’t come out of its boulder on rainy days.

name: Seviper

1.name: Fateful Fang
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Zangoose, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s archrival.

name: Zorua
flavour_text: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zoroark

ability.name: Illusive Trickery
ability.effect: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this Pokémon's attacks, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.

name: Inkay
flavour_text: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

name: Malamar

1.name: Mental Surge
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar’s control.

name: Skrelp
flavour_text: Skrelp evades its enemies by hiding amid drifting seaweed. It eats rotten seaweed to create its poison.

name: Dragalge
flavour_text: Using a liquid poison, Dragalge indiscriminately attacks anything that wanders into its territory. This poison can corrode the undersides of boats.

name: Altaria

1.name: Dragon Arcana
1.effect: If this Pokémon has 2 or more different types of Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

name: Farfetch'd
flavour_text: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

name: Lickitung

1.name: Stretch Tongue
1.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: If this Pokémon’s sticky saliva gets on you and you don’t clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won’t go away, either.

name: Lickilicky

1.name: Stretch Tongue
1.effect: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: Lickilicky’s strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky’s tongue can stretch so far.

name: Igglybuff

1.name: Sleepy Lullaby
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: Its body has a faintly sweet scent and is bouncy and soft. If it bounces even once, it cannot stop.

name: Teddiursa

1.name: Surprise Attack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: Its paws are soaked in oodles of honey. When nervous, Teddiursa will lick its paws and soon have a smile back on its face.

name: Ursaring
flavour_text: It usually wears a hardened expression, but when it’s licking up honey—which it loves—the joy it feels will cause it to break into a wide grin.

name: Miltank

1.name: Rolling Frenzy
1.effect: Until this Pokémon leaves the Active Spot, this Pokémon's Rolling Frenzy attack does +30 damage. This effect stacks.

flavour_text: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it’s been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

name: Azurill

1.name: Squishy Healing
1.effect: Heal 50 damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.

name: Swablu
flavour_text: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Zangoose

ability.name: Counterattack
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

flavour_text: It’s Seviper’s archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.

name: Fletchling

1.name: Quick Attack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

name: Inflatable Boat
card_text: The Retreat Cost of the [ W ] Pokémon this card is attached to is 1 less.

name: Memory Light
card_text: The Pokémon this card is attached to can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

name: Whitney
card_text: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Miltank, and it recovers from being Asleep, Paralyzed, and Confused.

name: Traveling Merchant
card_text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put all Pokémon Tool cards you find there into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

name: Morty
card_text: For each of your [ P ] Pokémon in play, look at that many cards from the top of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order.

name: Chimchar
flavour_text: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.

name: Monferno
flavour_text: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

name: Psyduck

1.name: Headache
1.effect: Your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn.

flavour_text: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck
flavour_text: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Krabby
flavour_text: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

name: Kingler

1.name: KO Crab
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 80 more damage.

flavour_text: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

name: Pyukumuku

ability.name: Innards Out
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 50 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

flavour_text: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Gible
flavour_text: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gabite
flavour_text: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

name: Paldean Wooper

1.name: Poison Jab
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

1.effect: Discard all [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

2.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

1.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
